name: ThermaSol Astra 3-4 Person Indoor Sauna Cabin
description: Description Appreciate the restorative benefits of sauna bathing with the Astra Sauna Cabin, which provides comfort, warmth, and timeless appeal within the walls of your home. Tyrol wooden paneling with inset black trim encapsulates the corner layout while transparent glass panels create an open, airy feel in any interior space. Step inside to find thermo-aspen benches offering natural textures perfect for enjoying the Harvia Virta's powerful performance. Multi-layer wood fiber insulation encapsulates the interior to ensure an even distribution of heat and steam during sauna sessions. Full-spectrum LEDs illuminate from recessed locations throughout the cabin, with the included control enabling a fully customizable ambiance. Supported by a 1-year warranty, the ThermaSol Astra indoor sauna blends relaxation and rejuvenation with energy efficient performance to establish the ideal modern indoor wellness space. Features Sustainably sourced Tyrol wood paneling with transparent semi-panoramic glass to effortlessly blend in with several interior styles Thermo-Aspen benches and backrests for superior comfort and stability while resisting moisture and warping Multi-layer wall insulation using sustainable wood fibers to improve heat retention and energy efficiency Harvia Virta electric sauna heater for powerful, evenly distributed heating performance Harvia Xenio sauna control touchpad to adjust time and temperature with repeat scheduling and WiFi connectivity through the MyHarvia App Full-spectrum recessed LED lighting with independent controls for a personalized ambiance Ideal for home wellness spaces, fitness rooms, spas, or boutique wellness centers Arrives flat-packed with installation instructions for straightforward assembly Dimensions: 85.4"W (216.9 cm) x 85.4"D (216.9 cm) x 83"H (210.8 cm) Designed and crafted in the U.S.A. What's Included Flat-Packed Indoor Sauna Harvia Virta 9kW Sauna Heater with Wi-Fi Harvia Xenio CX45 Digital Control with Wi-Fi Harvia AC3020 Sauna Stones (3) Temperature Sensor Headrest (2) Wood Platform MyHarvia App Installation Instructions Specifications Recommended capacity: 3-4 people Exterior (W × D × H): 85.4″ × 85.4″ × 83″ Heater: Harvia 9kW VIRTA Heater with Wi-Fi Sauna type: Traditional (Finnish) Installation: Indoor Lead time: Made to order, 8 weeks (plus 5–10 business days delivery) Shipping & Lead Time Freight is quoted separately for every order based on your delivery location and configuration. After you place your order, our team will contact you with your shipping quote before your build begins. Saunas are delivered fully assembled via flatbed trailer, and you'll be notified roughly two weeks before the scheduled delivery. A forklift or crane is required for placement, and a licensed electrician must connect the heater — manual offloading is not recommended. Documents Installation Manual Specification Sheet
